messages.text: Hi, I was looking at the b30. Could I pick up one of them and if there's any cost replacement

The Harlo B30 is $899 and you can get one. It's a pre-order right now, not on the shelf, and it ships by November 30.

I want to get the cost question right, Rob. Do you want the B30 as a new order on top of what you have? Or do you want it to replace something, like your Magic M. 40T or the two Thor P2s?

For comparison, the 40T on your order is $799, does about 36 TH/s on its standard setting, and ships December 7.
